turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.
SC-2074 has already shipped, so I can’t change the delivery address. A colleague will take over to see whether the parcel can still be redirected.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nell.ashcombe@example.com wants to redirect SC-2074. Policy check denied a standard address change because it already shipped. No new address provided and no request filed. Please review available options.
